z_bend_leg.model: sigma = K 32 F e / (pi d^3), e = d/2 + t_arm/2
z_bend_leg.receipt_test: form the Z-bend on an M02 rod, clamp the arm-hole end in a 2 mm plate with a 1.3 mm hole, load the rod end along its axis with 76 N (1.5 x the 51.0 N stall force) for 10 s: pass = no permanent set over 0.2 mm at the far end; a rod that fails is replaced by ASTM A228 music wire 1.2 mm and the test repeated

horn_blade.model: horizontal sections of the drawn outline (slices of electrical.horn_profile, hole not deducted below the hole edge); sigma = 6 F (z_hole - z) / (t w^2); bearing F / (d_pin t); shear-out F / (2 t e)

horn_rib_foam.model:
The rib is a 2 mm PETG plate in a slot through the elevon, bonded on both faces. MODEL: Euler-Bernoulli beam along x
   (EI = E t d(x)^3 / 12, d = rib depth) on an elastic foundation of foam shear on its two faces: transverse k_z = 2 G d / l, rotational
   k_t = 2 G d^3 / (12 l), axial k_x = 2 G d / l (the rib is axially rigid: uniform u); the horn force F (along x, at the hole height) and its moment
   about the rib mid-depth are applied over the blade base. Face shear tau = (G / l) x local displacement. VALIDITY: linear elastic foam, Winkler
   (no coupling between springs), small rotations. The rib is NOT rigid (lambda L >> 1, printed below), which is why a rigid-rib / weld-group
   formula is not used. INPUTS: E_PETG 2.1 GPa (fe_a.py nom, EST); foam G = E / (2 (1 + nu)), E 5-10 MPa (CHAIN.md ASM-D5 "8-10", review r2 5-10),
   nu 0.1 EST; shear penetration l 2-8 mm EST (the foundation is swept over G / l). ALLOWABLE: foam shear 86 kPa (EST, foam_103.py: 100 x 103/120).
   Skin (tape) paths are ignored: conservative for the foam faces.

elevon_torsion_foam_only.model: Saint-Venant thin open section, foam only: tau = T t_max / J

parts.model: slop along the rod = sum of the diametral clearances, elevon free play = slop / horn radius (small angle, rod along the horn tangent at neutral); clevis cheek holes are vendor parts with no published size ("-"): measured at E1
